verdict.rationale: Forter's Order Status API lets merchants report outcomes like payment authorization, fulfillment, and compensation granted, and dispute/chargeback webhooks feed confirmed fraud outcomes back into Forter's system — plausible feedback channels for model learning. However, no evidence explicitly confirms that analyst review-queue decisions or confirmed-fraud labels are used to retrain the fraud model/rules. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a review-queue-to-model feedback loop, confirmation that analyst dispositions update rules/models, any hands-on or independent evidence of model improvement from these inputs.
